source: Deterministic hybrid library: original procedural layers plus the explicitly documented CC0 recordings below.

externalSources.modifications: Auditioned from the public HQ preview only; not included in final assets.

externalSources.modifications: Auditioned from the public HQ preview only; not included in final assets.

externalSources.creator: modusmogulus
externalSources.modifications: Public HQ preview decoded and downmixed, rumble/hiss filtered, wrap-crossfaded into a stable loop, peak-normalized, then spatialized and gain/pitch-ramped at runtime.
externalSources.disposition: Selected; real field-recorded Cessna identity and the most stable repeatable propeller bed.

externalSources.creator: clif_creates
externalSources.modifications: Public HQ preview decoded to mono; distant approach and receding tail isolated, time-compressed, phone-focused, layered with restrained generated air punctuation, peak-normalized.
externalSources.disposition: Selected; natural distance arc complements the close propeller loop.
